Thanks for the ping. Short answers here with the suggested operational flow: 

1) Can we issue two invoices for same time window? Yes — we can generate separate invoices (Invoice A -> Novacorp SpA, Invoice B -> Novacorp EU Services) that together sum to the total add-on charge. Accounting note: both invoices must reference the same internal work order / SOW and the same service dates (Feb 25–Mar 6) so we have an auditable trail.

2) VAT treatment: for the Italy entity we will charge Italian VAT (if they are domestic taxable). For the Ireland entity, if they supply a valid EU VAT ID and we ship from US/IE where reverse charge applies, we will apply reverse-charge (VAT 0%) and include a note on the invoice: "VAT reverse charge - customer liable for VAT under Article 194/196 (or local equivalent)." We will need the VAT ID and a billing address (country) to support tax reporting.

3) Suggested billing deliverables:
- Two proforma invoices (P1/P2) for PO approval (EUR)
- After service completes, final invoices referencing P1/P2 and the SOW
- Payment instructions: bank transfer (SEPA) or credit card. If SEPA, Marcus please confirm beneficiary details we should provide.

4) Proration: we will prorate the add-on charge by actual days used. Our quote uses a daily unit price X EUR/day — final invoice will reconcile to actual provisioning window.

5) Documentation: attaching "invoice-split-template.xlsx" with the fields we require (legal name, VAT ID, billing address, PO number, purchase contact). Please confirm these fields back to us.

Cc: Marcus for payment instructions; Marissa for any contractual flags on issuing two invoices to one buyer.

— Karthik
